profile.address: 2500 West Union Hills Drive, Phoenix, AZ (general campus address, exact building among PHX-01/02/03/05 cluster unconfirmed)
profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, tagged Aligned Energy Data Center, sits at coordinates that correspond closely to 2500 West Union Hills Drive in Phoenix, Arizona, the 55-acre flagship address Aligned Data Centers own Phoenix location page lists for its cluster of buildings on that campus, referenced in company materials as the PHX-01, PHX-02, PHX-03, and PHX-05 group. Aligned own site discloses campus-level infrastructure standards for the Phoenix market, including a Tier III design approach with 3 megawatt generators and 2 megawatt uninterruptible power supply units per building, but does not break out individual capacity or square footage figures per building on that page, and no dedicated press release matching this exact coordinate to one specific building code among PHX-01 through PHX-05 could be located this session. A separate Aligned facility in the Phoenix market, PHX-06, sits at a distinct Chandler, Arizona address and earned Three Green Globes sustainability certification per a July 2025 Aligned press release, but that is a different building from this Union Hills campus record and should not be conflated with it. Given this ambiguity, no specific capacity, square footage, or building-code assignment beyond the general Union Hills campus location is claimed here. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, the name still reflected in this record OpenStreetMap tag, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
profile.research_note: Coordinates match the general Union Hills campus address on Aligned own Phoenix location page, but no source ties this specific OSM record to one exact building code among the PHX-01/02/03/05 cluster. PHX-06 explicitly ruled out as a different, Chandler-address building. Campus-level Tier III/generator/UPS specs disclosed, no per-building MW or sqft found.

profile.reading: Aligned Chicago ORD-01 sits at 505 Northwest Avenue in Northlake, Illinois, the first building on Aligned Data Centers Chicago-area campus and the market launch facility for the company in the Chicago metro. Per Aligned own April 2021 press release announcing the groundbreaking, ORD-01 was designed for 220,000 square feet and 48 megawatts of critical capacity, expandable toward roughly 60 megawatts. The facility participates in the Illinois Data Center Investment tax-exemption program, a state incentive for qualifying data center construction, and Aligned location page states it was the first Illinois data center to achieve Green Globes New Construction certification, a third-party sustainability rating. The Chicago campus sits on 18.5 acres per building, and a follow-up April 2022 press release announcing the adjacent ORD-02 building described the two-building campus as planned for more than 100 megawatts, with 108 megawatts of total redundant critical power capacity available across the site. Aligned, formerly Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations under the ODATA brand. Ownership has changed hands several times, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with Aligned own materials indicating a close around July 2026 that this research could not independently confirm through a dedicated press release. No specific tenant is named for ORD-01 in any source reviewed.
profile.research_note: 48 MW (expandable ~60 MW) and 220,000 sqft sourced to Aligned own April 2021 groundbreaking PR. Campus-level 100+ MW / 108 MW figures from the April 2022 ORD-02 groundbreaking PR are campus totals, presented as such, not assigned as this building own final capacity. Illinois tax program and Green Globes cert per Aligned location page.

profile.reading: Aligned Ashburn IAD-01 sits at 21890 Uunet Drive in Ashburn, Virginia, the first building on Aligned Data Centers 26-acre Northern Virginia campus in Data Center Alley, the world densest concentration of colocation and cloud infrastructure. Per the operator own June 2020 press release covering the campus second building, IAD-01, known internally as Phase 1, delivered 60 megawatts of critical capacity across 370,000 square feet and was completed in 2019 in roughly six and a half months, a build speed Aligned has repeatedly cited as a competitive differentiator. The facility was built to a Tier III design standard. Aligned itself, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes itself today as operating more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with its Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history. Macquarie Infrastructure Partners first invested in April 2018 alongside existing investor BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management confirmed as majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a more than 12 billion dollar capital raise in January 2025. In October 2025 Aligned announced that a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with the company own materials indicating a close around July 2026, though a dedicated closing press release could not be independently verified this session. No specific tenant is named for IAD-01 in any source reviewed, consistent with Aligned general practice of not disclosing individual hyperscale or enterprise customers by name.
profile.research_note: 60 MW / 370,000 sqft / 2019 completion sourced to Aligned own June 2020 PR describing IAD-01 as Phase 1 of the Ashburn campus. Ownership history and pending AIP/GIP/MGX acquisition sourced to Aligned own press releases, the July 2026 close date is sourced only to Aligned llms.txt summary file, not a discrete PR, flagged as such. No tenant named.

profile.reading: Aligned IAD-02 sits at 21821 Uunet Drive in Ashburn, Virginia, the second building on Aligned Data Centers Northern Virginia campus, adjacent to the earlier IAD-01 facility. Per the operator own press materials, construction began in mid-2020 with a two-story, 513,000 square foot building designed to be expandable to 120 megawatts of critical capacity, with an initial phase targeting roughly 40 megawatts by the end of 2020 and topping out reported in December 2020. Together, IAD-01 and IAD-02 make up a campus that Aligned press materials describe as planned for roughly 180 megawatts total. The general contractor on the project was HITT, per trade coverage of the topping-out. Aligned, formerly Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations under the ODATA brand. Ownership has changed hands several times: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners invested in April 2018 alongside BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management remaining majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a capital raise exceeding 12 billion dollars in January 2025. In October 2025 a consortium named AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a transaction valued near 40 billion dollars, with Aligned own materials pointing to a close around July 2026, a date this research could not independently confirm via a dedicated press release. No specific tenant is disclosed for IAD-02 in any source reviewed. Aligned own facility naming pattern, IAD for Washington Dulles airport code plus a sequence number, is consistent across its Northern Virginia buildings and mirrors the airport-code convention used broadly across the colocation industry for market shorthand.

profile.ownership: In transition as of this research date. Previously owned by private infrastructure funds managed by Macquarie Asset Management and co-investors. On October 15, 2025, the AI Infrastructure Partnership (AIP), MGX, and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) announced an agreement to acquire all equity in Aligned Data Centers at an approximately $40 billion enterprise value, reported as the largest data center transaction on record, with closing expected in the first half of 2026. This entry does not confirm whether that transaction has closed.

reading:
Aligned Data Centers is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, led by CEO Andrew Schaap. As of this research date the company is mid-transaction: previously owned by private infrastructure funds managed by Macquarie Asset Management, it was the subject of an October 15, 2025 announcement in which the AI Infrastructure Partnership, MGX, and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire all its equity at an approximately $40 billion enterprise value, reported as the largest data center transaction on record, with closing expected in the first half of 2026. This entry does not confirm whether that transaction has actually closed.

The company's current site describes 87 data centers under management and future development across 51 campuses, with 6.4 gigawatts of operational and planned capacity, and states its North American operations are 100 percent load matched with renewable sources. The October 2025 press release cites a slightly different snapshot, 50 campuses and more than 5 gigawatts, both figures recorded here rather than reconciled to one number. A flagship project, Project Caprock, is described as a sustainable 540 megawatt next-generation campus in Northwest Texas.

The registry here tracks 7 Aligned facilities across three states, Illinois, Texas, and Virginia, a small subset of the company's ten named North American markets, which also include Maryland, Atlanta, Ohio, Phoenix, Salt Lake City, and Hillsboro, Oregon, plus four Latin American countries. Aligned's stated multi-gigawatt capacity and pending $40 billion ownership change make it one of the largest single transactions recorded across any operator in this registry, and its research_status here should be revisited once the AIP/MGX/GIP acquisition closes.

sources.title: Aligned Data Centers press release, AIP/MGX/GIP to acquire all equity
